import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R

# Get the nut center pose and the handle grasp pose (both in world frame)
nut_center_pos, nut_center_quat = get_object_pose("white hollow center of the brown square nut")
grasp_pos, grasp_quat = sample_grasp_pose("extruded handle of the brown square nut")

# Compute the fixed rigid transform from the nut center frame to the grasp (end-effector) frame
# T_world_center and T_world_grasp -> T_center_grasp = inv(T_world_center) * T_world_grasp
R_center = R.from_quat([nut_center_quat[1], nut_center_quat[2], nut_center_quat[3], nut_center_quat[0]])
R_grasp = R.from_quat([grasp_quat[1], grasp_quat[2], grasp_quat[3], grasp_quat[0]])
R_center_grasp = R_center.inv() * R_grasp
p_center_grasp = R_center.inv().apply(grasp_pos - nut_center_pos)

# Grasp the nut by its handle
open_gripper()
goto_pose(grasp_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.1)
close_gripper()

# Lift the nut
lift_pos = grasp_pos.copy()
lift_pos[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(lift_pos, grasp_quat)

# Get the target block (peg) pose
block_pos, block_quat = get_object_pose("brown square block")

# Desired nut center pose: aligned with the block, with the nut center positioned above the block top
# Keep the nut's current orientation (so the gripper orientation stays reachable), only translate.
target_center_pos = block_pos.copy()
target_center_pos[2] = block_pos[2] + 0.05  # slightly above block so the nut slides down the peg

# Apply the fixed rigid transform to get the end-effector pose that places the nut center at the target
R_target_center = R_center  # keep same nut orientation as at grasp time
target_grasp_pos = target_center_pos + R_target_center.apply(p_center_grasp)
R_target_grasp = R_target_center * R_center_grasp
q_xyzw = R_target_grasp.as_quat()
target_grasp_quat = np.array([q_xyzw[3], q_xyzw[0], q_xyzw[1], q_xyzw[2]])

# Move above the peg, then descend to insert
goto_pose(target_grasp_pos, target_grasp_quat, z_approach=0.15)

# Release the nut and retreat
open_gripper()
retreat_pos = target_grasp_pos.copy()
retreat_pos[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(retreat_pos, target_grasp_quat)
goto_home_joint_position()
